descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de produse pentru apărare și domeniul spațial, Dezvoltare de software și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
Are you ambitious and would relish the opportunity to grow your career in a dynamic and innovative Romanian software company, by taking on new challenges and expand your professional horizons in a top-notch industry? 
 HR Design is recruiting for its client - the unique local provider of Command-and-Control systems for the Defense and Homeland Security Market and software solutions integrator, from Bucharest - a Senior .NET Software Developer !
 You will join a newly formed development team, on a new project , in a company with over 20 years of experience in C2 systems, delivering its own solutions to Defense (Land Forces) and Homeland Security entities in Romania.
 We encourage you to apply if you meet the following criteria:
you demonstrate experience in understanding and having an overview of the projects you have worked on, not just specific tasks
you have hands-on experience with low-level work - binary data formats and network protocols (TCP, UDP) - or you have worked in an adjacent area (telecom, networking, message parsing, communication systems)
you have the capability to analyze technical standards in order to be able to design and implement solutions which are compliant with these standards
you are willing to go one step further than the code and understand the operational meaning behind a technical specification, together with our in-house domain experts
you have technical and non-technical communication skills (up to the level of business analyst) with the client's representatives
you are proactive in identifying specific problems and propose solutions , like introducing relevant functionalities for application development
you prefer to have autonomy in project execution and you are comfortable working in a small team , where you are one of the most experienced people in the room
you have curiosity and a desire for professional development 
you like to work in an office (5 days a week) and be employed with a permanent contract (CIM) 
you are a Romanian citizen and able to obtain a security clearance - a requirement for certain projects in this field
 All the above will enable you to:
 1/ act as part of a development team to design, implement and document software functionalities for BC2A Software suite applications (based on NATO/military standards), in line with internal engineering and quality procedures
 2/ capture & analyze contract and project requirements
 3/ apply software design principles and work with Marketing/Product Owner, by designing of new products architecture
 4/ perform complex work in research, documenting the design in detail, development of new or existing products, tools and processes, all required for the operation, maintenance and testing of products
 5/ implement data exchange standards
 6/ implement new functionalities on existing products & modify existing software packages to fit beneficiary needs
 7/ perform unit testing/validation of successive versions of software to integrate with entire system hardware/software
 Therefore, it is mandatory to have these technical skills:
Degree in Computer Science or similar, with solid *senior-level experience* (minimum 5 years, 8+ preferred)
Programming concepts (OOP, SOLID)
C# programming language
Microsoft .NET Framework
SOAP/REST/WCF, WebAPI
Database principles
Networking
Network protocols (TCP, UDP)
Experience on working with binary data formats
Experience working with TFS/GIT for version control
Capability to analyze technical standards to be able to design and implement solutions which are compliant with these standards
Advanced level of English
 All the details regarding the salary package and the benefits offered by our client will be discussed with the selected candidates, during the first interview.
 If you like to take actions and fulfill them, send us your CV at contact@hrdesignconsulting.ro and we will be happy to include you in the selection process.
 For more information about the processing of personal data in the recruitment process, please refer to the information available on our website at: 
 https://www.hrdesignconsulting.ro/gdpr/informare-prelucrare-date-pentru-recrutare-personal/
